role.altitude: She still sits with the family, closes the casket, and leads the cortege. A florist note and a printed price label leave those acts in her week.
reach: Funeral attendants walk with the cortege and greet the family; she learns which doors they open and which names they have already heard.
Embalmers know which caskets are actually in the display; she learns which items she must leave off the available list.
Crematory operators hold the cremation time; she learns which slots are already booked before she calls a venue.
skills_to_grow: Write service time, place, and floral window as fields before any florist note is drafted.
Keep the family conversation, the casket closing, and the cortege as her own work.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent arranges a funeral, closes a casket, or comforts a family. She still makes those decisions in the room.

tasks.short: Plan and schedule funerals, burials, cremations, and floral delivery

steps.what: Read details for funerals, burials, or cremations
Schedule and coordinate the place of services
Plan the running order she will stand behind
Draft the floral delivery note from the plan
Check the floral delivery note against the plan
Send the accepted floral delivery note

tasks.design: She still phones the venue and the florist, and she still writes the service plan in {DOCS} with time, place, floral window, and florist contact. Code copies those fields into an {EMAIL} note. She checks the names, the time, and the flowers, and only that checked note is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan lived as prose in the funeral file, so each florist message was typed again by hand, and a wrong time could not be pulled back once the florist had it.
tasks.enabler_now: The same four fields she already writes can fill a fixed note without a model. The phone calls stay as they are.
tasks.still_hard: A venue that only answers the phone, and a family that changes the place after the note has gone, still need her on the call.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person the venue and the florist will hold to the time. The note only repeats what she has already agreed.
tasks.altitude: Her week still has the venue call, the florist call, and the plan she will stand behind. She gains a note that leaves only after she has checked that exact text.

reach.learn: Which slots are already booked before she calls the venue.

evidence.claim: The digest describes notice builders for obituaries. It does not describe a tool that books venues or florists. Copying fields she already wrote into a florist message is ordinary mail, graded from model knowledge.
Living relatives named in the florist note are personal data. The deceased fall outside that duty under recital 27.

assumptions: This task prices the venue call, the florist call, the written plan, and the retyped florist email. The family conversation is priced on the options task and the counsel task.

s4 produces the service plan. Fields are service time, service place, floral window, florist contact, and the relative name the florist may call. She writes them while she plans. If any field is empty, the note is not created and she finishes by phone.
The funeral file she reads in s1 already exists from the first arrangement call. If a wish is missing, she learns it on the venue or florist call and s1 stays the read she already does.
Field names are fixed at build. She does not keep a mapping or a template library, so incremental hours are zero.
Calls are not recorded. A relative's phone number goes into the email only after she has their consent on the call.
unknowns: Which venues expose a bookable slot the file can read, and which florists still take the order only by phone.
research_questions: Which florists still need only the phone call, so the email steps do not run?

already_counted.description: Reading the file, both phone calls, writing the plan, and checking the note stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: Field names are fixed at build. She does not keep a mapping or a template library.

approvals.approved_version: The delivery note s6 checked: service time, service place, floral window, florist contact, and the relative name the florist may call. A later edit of any of those fields voids this approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the florist is told only by phone, the note is never drafted and the send does not run, so the cut is zero. When she does send it, the conservative cut is the retype alone. The calls, the plan, and her check of the names and the time stay.

tasks.short: Close caskets and lead funeral corteges to the burial

steps.what: Show the funeral departure for churches or burial sites
Close caskets before the family is brought in
Lead funeral corteges from the chapel toward the gate

tasks.design: Before she leaves, {DOCS} shows the departure time and place already written on the service plan from the scheduling task. She closes the casket herself and leads the cortege to the church or the burial site.
tasks.previous_blocker: The departure sat in the same prose plan as the rest of the day, so she scanned it again in the preparation room. Closing the casket and walking the cortege have no digital stand-in.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the plan stores time and place as fields, a view can show those two fields. The physical acts stay with her.
tasks.still_hard: A family that asks to see the person again, a church that changes the door, and the pace of the cortege all sit with her in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: She decides when the casket is closed and she sets the pace the family can walk. A screen cannot do either.
tasks.altitude: Her week still includes closing the casket and leading the cortege. The glance at the departure time is the only shorter piece.

reach.learn: Which doors they open so she can lead without stopping the family.

evidence.claim: Closing a casket and leading a cortege stay physical. The digest says the ceremony stays with a person. No measured time cut is in the digest.

assumptions: The service plan is produced on task 39-4031.00:15200, with service time and service place. This step only shows those two fields. If the plan is missing, she reads the funeral file by hand and the show step does not run.
Closing the casket does not depend on the screen. She does it in the preparation room either way.
No mapping is kept for this view. Incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether the cortege route is fixed by the church or chosen that morning.
research_questions: Which departure facts the attendants need before she leaves the building?

already_counted.description: Closing the casket and leading the cortege stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The departure view uses fields already written on the service plan. She keeps no separate list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the plan has no structured time and place, she reads the file by hand and the show step does not run. When it runs, only that glance is shorter. Closing the casket and leading the cortege stay at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain funeral options and keep the casket display

steps.what: Read funeral service options, products, and merchandise
Choose which prices the casket display will show
Print accepted merchandise prices onto display labels
Maintain the casket display before visitors arrive
Provide information on those options to the family

tasks.design: She reads funeral options and merchandise prices in {DOCS} and chooses which prices the casket display will show. Code prints only that accepted set onto the display labels she now handwrites. She still places the caskets and still explains the options to the family in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices were copied by hand onto each label, and a stale price sat in the display until someone noticed it during a family visit.
tasks.enabler_now: The catalogue is already the price source. Printing the set she has chosen replaces the handwriting and stops there.
tasks.still_hard: Which casket is right for this family, and what she says while they stand in the room, stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the family can bear to look at and what they can afford. The label only shows a price she has already accepted.
tasks.altitude: The visit and the work of keeping the display stay in her week. She decides the price set before any label is printed.

reach.task: Know which caskets are in the display
reach.learn: Which items she must leave off the available list.

evidence.claim: The digest measures obituaries and donation lookups. Display upkeep and handwritten price labels are graded from model knowledge, with no measured time cut in the digest.

assumptions: The merchandise catalogue already sits in {DOCS}. She chooses the accepted price and item set in s2. She does not keep a field map. Incremental hours are zero.
If a supplier already prints the labels, the print step does not run and she places those labels by hand.
The talk with the family uses the catalogue and the display. The labels do not shorten that conversation.
unknowns: Whether merchandise prices already arrive printed from the supplier.
research_questions: Which casket items do embalmers say must stay off the available list?

already_counted.description: Reading the catalogue, choosing prices, keeping the display, and talking with the family stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: The catalogue is the price source. She does not keep a mapping of labels to items.

approvals.approved_version: The price and item set s2 chose for the display. A later change to any price or item voids this print.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the supplier already prints the labels, the print does not run. When she handwrites them today, the conservative cut is that handwriting only, and only for prices she has already chosen. The talk and the display work stay at full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Offer counsel and comfort to bereaved families

steps.what: Read which bereaved families or friends will attend
Offer counsel and comfort for as long as they need

tasks.design: She reads who is expected in the funeral file and then sits with the bereaved family or their friends. The conversation stays hers for as long as they need. The counsel itself is not copied into another record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comfort depends on what this family can hear today. The digest keeps that conversation with a person, and there is no paperwork in this task to shorten.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new makes the conversation faster. The file already names who is coming, which is the read she already does.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when to speak, when to stop, and what this family can carry stays with her in the room.
tasks.human_edge: They are talking to her, not to a prepared text. She stays until they are ready to stop.
tasks.altitude: Nothing in this task moves. She still offers counsel and comfort herself.

reach.learn: Which names they have already heard before she sits down.

evidence.claim: The digest says the conversation with the family stays with a person. This task has no paperwork change to price, so the saving is zero. That reading is model knowledge of the digest, and the digest has no measured case.
Family names in the arrangement file are personal data of living relatives. The deceased fall outside that duty under recital 27.

assumptions: A short file from the first call already names who will attend. If it does not, she learns the names while she sits with them, and s1 is the listening she already does.
She does not write the counsel into a new record. There is no template to maintain, so incremental hours are zero.
The digest says this conversation stays with a person, so both ends of the range are zero.
unknowns: Whether this family wants a second person from the firm in the room.
research_questions: Which names have the attendants already heard before she sits down?

already_counted.description: Reading who will attend and sitting with the family stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: No template and no mapping. The conversation is not turned into a record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The digest says the conversation stays with a person, and this task has no paperwork the design changes. Low and high are both zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
